name: EgoVid-5M
tagline: 5M 1080p clips (~120 frames each) cut from Ego4D, each with LLM text descriptions and SfM+IMU-fused camera trajectories for video generation

annotations.format: CSV (clip metadata, captions, IMU) + NPY camera poses (poses.zip)
annotations.coverageNote: All 5M clips carry LLaVA/Qwen2 descriptions and SfM+IMU camera poses; EgoVid-65K has IMU-validated kinematics; 1.2K val clips. Videos come from Ego4D.

narrations.note: llava_cap detailed captions + 'name' action descriptions (LLaVA-NeXT-Video, Qwen2)

action_labels.note: verb_cls / noun_cls per clip (from Ego4D narrations)

camera_pose.note: Per-frame ego camera extrinsics: ParticleSfM + IMU, Kalman-fused (fused_pose.npy)

annotations.sample:
# egovid-val.csv columns (dataset_infos.json)
video_id, name, frame_num, fps,
gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z, accl_x, accl_y, accl_z,
noun_cls, verb_cls, llava_cap,
flow_mean, flow_0_4, flow_4_8, flow_8_12, flow_12_16, flow_16_,
ti_sim, ii_sim, dover_score, egovideo_score

# poses/<video_id>_<start>_<end>/
intri.npy [3,3]  sfm_pose.npy [N,4,4]  imu_pose.npy  fused_pose.npy (recommended)  cost.txt
